package leak

import (
	"strings"

	d "github.com/Windemiatrix/photosync/internal/domain"
)

type token = d.Secret

type plain d.Secret

type Config struct {
	Token  d.Secret
	secret d.Secret
	alias  token
	list   []d.Secret
	array  [2]d.Secret
	byName map[string]d.Secret
	byKey  map[d.Secret]bool
	ptr    *d.Secret
	d.Secret
}

type inner struct {
	Token d.Secret
}

type holder struct {
	cfg  Config
	Cfg  Config
	cfgp *Config
	inner
}

type node struct {
	next []node
}

func Use(s d.Secret, t token, p plain) {
	_ = string(s)
	_ = []byte(t)
	_ = plain(s)
	_ = strings.ToUpper(string(s))
	_ = s[0]
	for range s {
	}
	_ = any(s)
	_ = token(s)
	_ = d.Secret("x")
	_ = s[1:]
	_ = len(s)
	_ = s == "x"
	_ = p[0]
	var local struct{ s d.Secret }
	_ = local
}
